_comment: Sell order store for managing trigger sell orders. Multiple orders can have 'execute: true' and will be queued based on queue_id.

_instructions.execute: Set to true to mark this order for execution
_instructions.success: Automatically set to true after successful execution
_instructions.queue_id: (Optional) Queue position for execution (1, 2, 3, etc.). Orders with execute=true are executed in ascending queue_id order. If not specified, defaults to 999.
_instructions.price: Sell price per unit (trigger price calculated as price / 1.02, floored to 1 decimal)
_instructions.time: (Optional) Scheduled execution time in HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format
_instructions.sell: Must be true for sell orders
